title: Export the job id into the pane and read activity.json before the screen classifier at every wait point
action: In mailbox.rs (pure, no fs): add `activity_path(bee_dir, job_id)` -> `.bee/mailbox/<job-id>/activity.json`, and `parse_activity_text(text, current_round, now) -> Option<ActivityState>` that returns None when the JSON is malformed, when `round` is below current_round (per D2: an older round is the launch-id fence), or when `at` is older than a fixed freshness bound (pick one constant, name it, record it in the cap; 120s is the default suggestion). In run.rs: (a) the fresh-spawn env export at the BEE_HERDING_WORKER marker also exports `BEE_HERDING_JOB_ID=<job-id>` (per D2); (b) add one wrapper, e.g. `status_with_activity(bee_dir, job_id, round, now, fallback: &mut dyn FnMut() -> Option<String>) -> Option<String>`, that reads activity.json through the existing fs seam, maps blocked|waiting_input -> "blocked" and working -> "working", and otherwise calls the fallback (the screen classifier / herdr status) — per D3; (c) route the three wait points through it: the ready gate, deliver_pointer's blocked preflight and submit-observed check, and the round poll. Do not touch ack/result handling — ack-N.json and result-N.json stay the only delivered/done truth (D3). Tests in run.rs with the existing fake transport: (1) activity.json blocked + screen idle -> the wait ends Blocked; (2) activity.json working + herdr stalled reply -> submit counts as observed, no resend; (3) stale `at` or lower round -> fallback answer wins; (4) no activity.json -> behavior byte-identical to today (existing tests stay green untouched). mailbox.rs unit tests for parse_activity_text.

truths: A herded pane whose activity.json says blocked ends the wait as blocked even when the screen reads idle
Without activity.json every existing herding test passes unchanged
